1.english_reference: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick .

traditions.WLC: בָּ עֵ֣ת הַ הִ֔יא חָלָ֖ה אֲבִיָּ֥ה בֶן יָרָבְעָֽם
traditions.VUL: In témpore illo ægrotávit Abía fílius Ieróboam .
traditions.KJV: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick .

2.english_reference: And Jeroboam said to his wife , Arise , I pray thee , and disguise thyself ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר יָרָבְעָ֜ם לְ אִשְׁתּ֗ וֹ ק֤וּמִי נָא֙ וְ הִשְׁתַּנִּ֔ית
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Ieróboam uxóri suæ : Surge , et commúta hábitum ,
traditions.KJV: And Jeroboam said to his wife , Arise , I pray thee , and disguise thyself ,

2.english_reference: that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam ;

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֣א יֵֽדְע֔וּ כִּי אתי אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֑ם
traditions.VUL: ne cognoscáris quod sis uxor Ieróboam :
traditions.KJV: that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הָלַ֣כְתְּ שִׁלֹ֗ה
traditions.VUL: et vade in Silo ,
traditions.KJV: and get thee to Shiloh :

2.english_reference: behold , there [ is ] Ahijah the prophet ,

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּה שָׁם֙ אֲחִיָּ֣ה הַ נָּבִ֔יא הֽוּא
traditions.VUL: ubi est Ahías prophéta ,
traditions.KJV: behold , there [ is ] Ahijah the prophet ,

2.english_reference: which told me that [ I should be ] king over this people .

traditions.WLC: דִבֶּ֥ר עָלַ֛ י לְ מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל הָ עָ֥ם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.VUL: qui locútus est mihi quod regnatúrus essem super pópulum hunc .
traditions.KJV: which told me that [ I should be ] king over this people .

3.english_reference: And take with thee ten loaves , and cracknels , and a cruse of honey ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לָקַ֣חַתְּ בְּ֠ יָדֵ ךְ עֲשָׂרָ֨ה לֶ֧חֶם וְ נִקֻּדִ֛ים וּ בַקְבֻּ֥ק דְּבַ֖שׁ
traditions.VUL: Tolle quoque in manu tua decem panes , et crústulam , et vas mellis ,
traditions.KJV: And take with thee ten loaves , and cracknels , and a cruse of honey ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ֣את אֵלָ֑י
traditions.VUL: et vade ad illum :
traditions.KJV: and go to him :

3.english_reference: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child .

traditions.WLC: ו ה֚וּא יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔ ךְ מַה יִּֽהְיֶ֖ה לַ נָּֽעַר
traditions.VUL: ipse enim indicábit tibi quid eventúrum sit púero huic .
traditions.KJV: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child .

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֔ם
traditions.VUL: Fecit ut díxerat , uxor Ieróboam :
traditions.KJV: And Jeroboam ’s wife did so ,

4.english_reference: and arose , and went to Shiloh , and came to the house of Ahijah .

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּ֨קָם֙ וַ תֵּ֣לֶךְ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַ תָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֣ית אֲחִיָּ֑ה
traditions.VUL: et consúrgens ábiit in Silo , et venit in domum Ahíæ :
traditions.KJV: and arose , and went to Shiloh , and came to the house of Ahijah .

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲחִיָּ֨הוּ֙ לֹֽא יָכֹ֣ל לִ רְא֔וֹת
traditions.VUL: at ille non póterat vidére ,
traditions.KJV: But Ahijah could not see ;

4.english_reference: for his eyes were set by reason of his age .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י קָ֥מוּ עֵינָ֖י ו מִ שֵּׂיבֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: quia caligáverant óculi eius præ senectúte .
traditions.KJV: for his eyes were set by reason of his age .

5.english_reference: And the LORD said unto Ahijah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יהוָ֞ה אָמַ֣ר אֶל אֲחִיָּ֗הוּ
traditions.VUL: Dixit autem Dóminus ad Ahíam :
traditions.KJV: And the LORD said unto Ahijah ,

5.english_reference: Behold , the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son ; for he [ is ] sick :

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֡ם בָּאָ֣ה לִ דְרֹשׁ֩ דָּבָ֨ר מֵ עִמְּ ךָ֤ אֶל בְּנָ הּ֙ כִּֽי חֹלֶ֣ה ה֔וּא
traditions.VUL: Ecce uxor Ieróboam ingréditur ut cónsulat te super fílio suo qui ægrótat :
traditions.KJV: Behold , the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son ; for he [ is ] sick :

5.english_reference: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her :

traditions.WLC: כָּ זֹ֥ה וְ כָ זֶ֖ה תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֑י
traditions.VUL: hæc et hæc loquéris ei .
traditions.KJV: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her :

5.english_reference: for it shall be , when she cometh in , that she shall feign herself [ to be ] another [ woman ] .

traditions.WLC: הָ וִ יהִ֣י כְ בֹאָ֔ הּ וְ הִ֖יא מִתְנַכֵּרָֽה
traditions.VUL: Cum ergo illa intráret , et dissimuláret se esse quæ erat ,
traditions.KJV: for it shall be , when she cometh in , that she shall feign herself [ to be ] another [ woman ] .

6.english_reference: And it was [ so ] , when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet , as she came in at the door ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֩ כִ שְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲחִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת ק֤וֹל רַגְלֶ֨י הָ֙ בָּאָ֣ה בַ פֶּ֔תַח
traditions.VUL: audívit Ahías sónitum pedum eius introeúntis per óstium ,
traditions.KJV: And it was [ so ] , when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet , as she came in at the door ,

6.english_reference: that he said , Come in , thou wife of Jeroboam ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֕אמֶר בֹּ֖אִי אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֑ם
traditions.VUL: et ait : Ingrédere uxor Ieróboam :
traditions.KJV: that he said , Come in , thou wife of Jeroboam ;

6.english_reference: why feignest thou thyself [ to be ] another ?

traditions.WLC: לָ֣ מָּה זֶּ֗ה אַ֚תְּ מִתְנַכֵּרָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: quare áliam te esse símulas ?
traditions.KJV: why feignest thou thyself [ to be ] another ?

6.english_reference: for I [ am ] sent to thee [ with ] heavy [ tidings ] .

traditions.WLC: וְ אָ֣נֹכִ֔י שָׁל֥וּחַ אֵלַ֖יִ ךְ קָשָֽׁה
traditions.VUL: ego autem missus sum ad te durus núntius .
traditions.KJV: for I [ am ] sent to thee [ with ] heavy [ tidings ] .

traditions.WLC: לְכִ֞י אִמְרִ֣י לְ יָרָבְעָ֗ם
traditions.VUL: Vade , et dic Ieróboam :
traditions.KJV: Go , tell Jeroboam ,

7.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel ,

7.english_reference: Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people , and made thee prince over my people Israel ,

traditions.WLC: יַ֛עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲרִימֹתִ֖י ךָ מִ תּ֣וֹךְ הָ עָ֑ם וָ אֶתֶּנְ ךָ֣ נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥ י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.VUL: Quia exaltávi te de médio pópuli , et dedi te ducem super pópulum meum Israel :
traditions.KJV: Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people , and made thee prince over my people Israel ,

8.english_reference: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David , and gave it thee :

traditions.WLC: וָ אֶקְרַ֤ע אֶת הַ מַּמְלָכָה֙ מִ בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד וָ אֶתְּנֶ֖ הָ לָ֑ ךְ
traditions.VUL: et scidi regnum domus David , et dedi illud tibi ,
traditions.KJV: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David , and gave it thee :

8.english_reference: and [ yet ] thou hast not been as my servant David ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא הָיִ֜יתָ כְּ עַבְדִּ֣ י דָוִ֗ד
traditions.VUL: et non fuísti sicut servus meus David ,
traditions.KJV: and [ yet ] thou hast not been as my servant David ,

8.english_reference: who kept my commandments , and who followed me with all his heart , to do [ that ] only [ which was ] right in mine eyes ;

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁמַ֨ר מִצְוֺתַ֜ י וַ אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֤ךְ אַחֲרַ י֙ בְּ כָל לְבָב֔ וֹ לַ עֲשׂ֕וֹת רַ֖ק הַ יָּשָׁ֥ר בְּ עֵינָֽ י
traditions.VUL: qui custodívit mandáta mea , et secútus est me in toto corde suo , fáciens quod plácitum esset in conspéctu meo :
traditions.KJV: who kept my commandments , and who followed me with all his heart , to do [ that ] only [ which was ] right in mine eyes ;

9.english_reference: But hast done evil above all that were before thee :

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּ֣רַע לַ עֲשׂ֔וֹת מִ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר הָי֣וּ לְ פָנֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.VUL: sed operátus es mala super omnes , qui fuérunt ante te ,
traditions.KJV: But hast done evil above all that were before thee :

9.english_reference: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods , and molten images , to provoke me to anger ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תֵּ֡לֶךְ וַ תַּעֲשֶׂה לְּ ךָ֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים אֲחֵרִ֤ים וּ מַסֵּכוֹת֙ לְ הַכְעִיסֵ֔ נִי
traditions.VUL: et fecísti tibi deos aliénos et conflátiles , ut me ad iracúndiam provocáres ,
traditions.KJV: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods , and molten images , to provoke me to anger ,

9.english_reference: and hast cast me behind thy back :

traditions.WLC: וְ אֹתִ֥ י הִשְׁלַ֖כְתָּ אַחֲרֵ֥י גַוֶּֽ ךָ
traditions.VUL: me autem proiecísti post corpus tuum :
traditions.KJV: and hast cast me behind thy back :

10.english_reference: Therefore , behold , I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam ,

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן הִנְ נִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא רָעָה֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֔ם
traditions.VUL: idcírco ecce ego indúcam mala super domum Ieróboam ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore , behold , I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam ,

10.english_reference: and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall , [ and ] him that is shut up and left in Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הִכְרַתִּ֤י לְ יָֽרָבְעָם֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּ קִ֔יר עָצ֥וּר וְ עָז֖וּב בְּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.VUL: et percútiam de Ieróboam mingéntem ad paríetem , et clausum , et novíssimum in Israel :
traditions.KJV: and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall , [ and ] him that is shut up and left in Israel ,

10.english_reference: and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam , as a man taketh away dung , till it be all gone .

traditions.WLC: וּ בִֽעַרְתִּי֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית יָרָבְעָ֔ם כַּ אֲשֶׁ֛ר יְבַעֵ֥ר הַ גָּלָ֖ל עַד תֻּמּֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et mundábo relíquias domus Ieróboam , sicut mundári solet fimus usque ad purum .
traditions.KJV: and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam , as a man taketh away dung , till it be all gone .

11.english_reference: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat

traditions.WLC: הַ מֵּ֨ת לְ יָֽרָבְעָ֤ם בָּ עִיר֙ יֹאכְל֣וּ הַ כְּלָבִ֔ים
traditions.VUL: Qui mórtui fúerint de Ieróboam in civitáte , cómedent eos canes :
traditions.KJV: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat ;

11.english_reference: and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ מֵּת֙ בַּ שָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֣וֹף הַ שָּׁמָ֑יִם
traditions.VUL: qui autem mórtui fúerint in agro , vorábunt eos aves cæli :
traditions.KJV: and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
traditions.VUL: quia Dóminus locútus est .
traditions.KJV: for the LORD hath spoken [ it ] .

12.english_reference: Arise thou therefore , get thee to thine own house

traditions.WLC: וְ אַ֥תְּ ק֖וּמִי לְכִ֣י לְ בֵיתֵ֑ ךְ
traditions.VUL: Tu ígitur surge , et vade in domum tuam :
traditions.KJV: Arise thou therefore , get thee to thine own house : [ and ]

12.english_reference: when thy feet enter into the city , the child shall die

traditions.WLC: בְּ בֹאָ֥ה רַגְלַ֛יִ ךְ הָ עִ֖ירָ ה וּ מֵ֥ת הַ יָּֽלֶד
traditions.VUL: et in ipso intróitu pedum tuórum in urbem , moriétur puer ,
traditions.KJV: when thy feet enter into the city , the child shall die .

13.english_reference: And all Israel shall mourn for him , and bury him

traditions.WLC: וְ סָֽפְדוּ ל֤ וֹ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ קָבְר֣וּ אֹת֔ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et planget eum omnis Israel , et sepéliet :
traditions.KJV: And all Israel shall mourn for him , and bury him :

13.english_reference: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי זֶ֣ה לְ בַדּ֔ וֹ יָבֹ֥א לְ יָרָבְעָ֖ם אֶל קָ֑בֶר
traditions.VUL: iste enim solus inferétur de Ieróboam in sepúlcrum ,
traditions.KJV: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave ,

13.english_reference: because in him there is found good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam

traditions.WLC: יַ֣עַן נִמְצָא ב֞ וֹ דָּבָ֣ר ט֗וֹב אֶל יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ בֵ֥ית יָרָבְעָֽם
traditions.VUL: quia invéntus est super eo sermo bonus a Dómino Deo Israel in domo Ieróboam .
traditions.KJV: because in him there is found [ some ] good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam .

14.english_reference: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵקִים֩ יְהוָ֨ה ל֥ וֹ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.VUL: Constítuet autem sibi Dóminus regem super Israel ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel ,

14.english_reference: who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַכְרִ֛ית אֶת בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם זֶ֣ה הַ יּ֑וֹם
traditions.VUL: qui percútiet domum Ieróboam in hac die ,
traditions.KJV: who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day :

traditions.WLC: וּ מֶ֖ה גַּם עָֽתָּה
traditions.VUL: et in hoc témpore :
traditions.KJV: but what ? even now .

15.english_reference: For the LORD shall smite Israel , as a reed is shaken in the water

traditions.WLC: וְ הִכָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנ֣וּד הַ קָּנֶה֮ בַּ מַּיִם֒
traditions.VUL: et percútiet Dóminus Deus Israel , sicut movéri solet arúndo in aqua :
traditions.KJV: For the LORD shall smite Israel , as a reed is shaken in the water ,

15.english_reference: and he shall root up Israel out of this good land , which he gave to their fathers

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַ֣שׁ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֠ עַל הָ אֲדָמָ֨ה הַ טּוֹבָ֤ה הַ זֹּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַן֙ לַ אֲב֣וֹתֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: et evéllet Israel de terra bona hac , quam dedit pátribus eórum ,
traditions.KJV: and he shall root up Israel out of this good land , which he gave to their fathers ,

15.english_reference: and shall scatter them beyond the river

traditions.WLC: וְ זֵרָ֖ ם מֵ עֵ֣בֶר לַ נָּהָ֑ר
traditions.VUL: et ventilábit eos trans flumen :
traditions.KJV: and shall scatter them beyond the river ,

15.english_reference: because they have made their groves , provoking the LORD to anger

traditions.WLC: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ אֶת אֲשֵׁ֣רֵי הֶ֔ם מַכְעִיסִ֖ים אֶת יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: quia fecérunt sibi lucos , ut irritárent Dóminum .
traditions.KJV: because they have made their groves , provoking the LORD to anger .

16.english_reference: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam

traditions.WLC: וְ יִתֵּ֖ן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּ גְלַ֞ל חַטֹּ֤אות יָֽרָבְעָם֙
traditions.VUL: Et tradet Dóminus Israel propter peccáta Ieróboam ,
traditions.KJV: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam ,

16.english_reference: who did sin , and who made Israel to sin

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א וַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.VUL: qui peccávit , et peccáre fecit Israel .
traditions.KJV: who did sin , and who made Israel to sin .

17.english_reference: And Jeroboam ’s wife arose , and departed , and came to Tirzah

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּ֨קָם֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַ תֵּ֖לֶךְ וַ תָּבֹ֣א תִרְצָ֑תָ ה
traditions.VUL: Surréxit ítaque uxor Ieróboam , et ábiit , et venit in Thersa :
traditions.KJV: And Jeroboam ’s wife arose , and departed , and came to Tirzah : [ and ]

17.english_reference: when she came to the threshold of the door , the child died
